records.text: Owens said she received information alleging the J6 pipe bomber was a woman from Nancy Pelosi’s office and that everyone on Capitol Hill knew this; she explicitly said “allegedly.”
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: The feds were behind this. I actually received information that everyone on Capitol Hill knows that the individual was actually out of Nancy Pelosi's office and it was a woman, allegedly.
